title: Malaysian Smoked Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with smoked chicken, crunchy olives, and a tangy sauce.
instructions: 1. Slice the smoked chicken breast into thin strips.
2. In a small bowl, mix together the Malaysian peanut sauce and smoked paprika (if using).
3. Lay the opulent wrap flat on a clean surface.
4. Spread a quarter of the peanut sauce mixture onto the center of the wrap.
5. Arrange the sliced red onion and chopped cilantro on top of the sauce.
6. Add the sliced smoked chicken breast on top of the onion and cilantro.
7. Sprinkle the crunchy olives over the chicken.
8. Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a neat cylinder.
9. Slice in half and serve immediately.
